verdict.rationale: Front-door access is a fair axis for a government service that publishes guidance pages. The probes show the opposite of the story: a standard identified keyless agent got an HTTP 403 with an Akamai "Access Denied" marker at www.ftb.ca.gov/robots.txt, and the same edge denial at webapp.ftb.ca.gov. That is a bot wall in front of the public surface, so the product does not deliver this story. Confidence is medium because guidance pages beyond robots.txt were not fetched directly, but the edge wall covers the whole host.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
